page.overview:
Who is Bluestreak TFP?

discoveries to others. He tends to let loose with a self-conscious nervous flood of rambling, jumbled, over-detailed explanation that even a fellow expert on the subject might have difficulty following. Thankfully he comes with a "translator." His dear friend and partner Prowl has the engineering skill to keep up with Streak and the more confident social skills to nudge his friend back from the edge of incoherence or sum up what he's attempting to say for any confused listeners.

During the Age of Wrath, Bluestreak and Prowl were the bots who were able to decipher intercepted Quintesson information and reveal that the alien occupiers were secretly building space bridges with the intent to ship the Transformers off-world as slaves. They also devised a test that proved the Quintessons did not invent space bridge technology themselves and had likely stolen it.

After the Quintessons' defeat, Bluestreak was honored by being the first bot in the ceremonial relay of a torch containing power from the Well of All Sparks to ignite a new Well on the Archon colony. Bluestreak later moved to Archon despite misgivings about being separated from Prowl, who remained on Cybertron.

When the deadly galactic Rust Plague threatened all Cybertronic life and the space bridges were ordered destroyed, a desperate Prowl disobeyed orders and seized control of a bridge in hopes of retrieving Bluestreak. However, the plague had already reached Archon and although not visibly infected Bluestreak refused to risk spreading the disease by returning home. Despite a heartbroken Prowl's pleading, Bluestreak would not budge, offering his friend the hope that the authorities on Archon might still stop the spread of the plague with fire. A crushed Prowl was forced to detonate the bridge and Cybertron lost contact with all its former colonies.
